frictions.description: Settings page navigation causes complete state reset - Proxy tab UI appears but unmounts when attempting interactions
frictions.resolution: Could not resolve - appears to be React component lifecycle issue triggered by Tauri API errors

frictions.description: Console shows 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading transformCallback)' errors repeatedly - Tauri invoke() failing in browser context
frictions.resolution: localStorage fallback exists in use-settings.ts but errors cause cascading failures

blockers.description: Tauri backend unavailable - Running app in browser (localhost:1420) without Tauri desktop wrapper causes all invoke() calls to fail with transformCallback errors. The app appears to require the full Tauri desktop environment to function properly.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Set localStorage with test proxies (10.0.0.201:8080, 10.0.0.202:8080). Proxies loaded successfully (2 Edit/Delete button pairs visible), but any interaction (enable toggle, click edit/delete) causes component unmount and state reset.

blockers.description: React component lifecycle issue - Proxy settings components mount with correct initial state (proxies visible, buttons present) but unmount immediately upon any user interaction attempt
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried multiple interaction methods (click refs, find text click, semantic locators) - all result in component unmounting

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 0 passed, 0 failed, 2 blocked. Both VAL-CFG-007 (Edit proxy) and VAL-CFG-008 (Delete proxy) are blocked due to Tauri backend unavailability in browser context. The app requires the full Tauri desktop environment to function - running in browser causes invoke() calls to fail, which triggers React component unmounting when attempting any proxy settings interactions. localStorage fallback exists but the errors cause cascading failures before the fallback can work properly.
